{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Admirable'' effort for a droid&mdash;if it had feelings we would be giving it a hero's welcome, I am sure.|[[Unidentified Neimoidian councilor]]|<ref name="Update" />}}
This '''B1 battle droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was stationed on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Unidentified Outer Rim planet (Separatist factory)|planet]] controlled by the Separatists. This [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] was present when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Raid on a Separatist factory|raided]] a [[Unidentified Separatist factory|Separatist factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. In the midst of the battle, this droid managed to recover data plans for a new model of [[Updated battle droid|upgraded battle droid]] and deliver them to a pair of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] officers. While its superiors spoke with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] regarding how this new droid unit would make the standard issue battle droid obsolete, this droid acted out against its superiors, opening fire on the command module containing the upgraded schematics. Initially believing the firing to be a weapons malfunction, further inspection by a [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|Neimoidian guard]] revealed that the droid's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] showed no signs of deterioration. With this revelation, Dooku ordered the droid's destruction.<ref name="Update" />
